conventions:
CR1 shared world (order V4_COMBO_V1_CR1 s3; ADR-0010 decision 3; contract V4). New file; v4_world,
m1_ruler, m2h_common, m2h_dense_common and the B5 dbg_memo trainer are imported, never modified.

  combo    COMBO_V1's 8 h1 handwritten H168 cells. Signs = sign of the rank IC over the A half only
           (signal every 24 h inside every A tile, 168 h forward, TOP100, delisting layer); a cell is
           active if its IC coverage >= 50 %; equal weight. Per hour per cell: average rank -> z over
           TOP100 & finite (>= 20 coins). C = N / K with N = sum sign z, K = finite active cells; C is NaN
           where K < min(5, n_active). Fit once on the real labels; the same combo in every world.
  formula  z_f = average-rank z of the formula's TOP100 signal per row (>= 20 coins). combo + f =
           (N + z_f) / (K + 1) where z_f is finite, C where it is not, NaN where C is NaN: f enters as
           a ninth equal-weight cell.
  marginal per tile: log NAV(combo + f) - log NAV(combo) on the same ruler (v4_world.tile / books:
           rank_weights -> held_path H168 -> delisting layer -> settle_multi; flat6 / cost0; lag 1).
  halves   v4_world.ab_tiles: 30 A / 30 B tiles of 336 h, alternate calendar months from 2021-01,
           >= 168 h buffer to both month edges. Training and hall of fame on A, ranking on B.
  worlds   real; null = D.null_shard (per hour one coin permutation of fwd / eligible / funding inside
           the TOP100 of the signal row; terminals untouched); p8 / p32: fwd[t] += alpha s_perp[t-1],
           s_perp = D.plant_signal (DELTA(TS_MEAN(log_quote_volume,168),168), TOP100 rank z) with C
           regressed out per hour (OLS with intercept over coins where both are finite), re-standardised;
           alpha such that s_perp alone (full book, cost0, A tiles) gains +8 / +32 bp/day. The delisting
           layer is installed after every world swap.
trainer:
CR1 trainer (order V4_COMBO_V1_CR1 s3; ADR-0010 decision 3; contract V4). New file. The sampler, grammar
mask, policy-gradient step, elite pool and checkpoint plumbing are m2h_b5_trainer_dbg_memo's functions,
imported unchanged (that file is not modified); the world and the reward are cr1_common's.

  reward   per formula: mean over the drawn A tiles of the marginal full-book net log NAV (flat6) of
           combo + f over the combo alone (cr1_common docstring). Cost is in the reward because a ninth
           cell changes the combo's turnover; the combo's own cost is subtracted out.
  update   16 of the 30 A tiles per update (B tiles never enter training); batch 128 (T1/T2/T3 quota),
           H168 only; within-family z +-3 over valid, invalid -1, entropy 0.03 (dbg_memo --select full).
  speed    memo: each (body, hold) scored once per update; the VM runs on the GPU and hands the tile
           signals to --workers CPU processes (1 thread each) as soon as they are ready, so the ruler
           overlaps the VM. Step times are logged per update. Selftest at start: pool result ==
           in-process result, bit for bit, for the plant formula (production path).

    python -I cr1_trainer.py OUT --mode p8 --updates 256 [--resume auto]

decisions.smoke: 16 updates p32: every update n_valid >= 20, finite loss, pool selftest bit-equal, receipt -> PC; else stop (code bug, not evidence)
decisions.pc: p8, budget = --updates. Round on B: frozen = top 10 of the hall of fame by B-half marginal K10 net. No frozen formula with corr_s(B) > 0.7 -> STOP, report 'PC not found' (trainer; the ruler is checked in CR1_ALPHA.json). Else NULL with the same budget.
decisions.null: max B-half marginal K10 net over the NULL frozen set = the bar. PC found = a PC frozen formula with corr > 0.7 AND B score > bar. Not found -> STOP, report. Found -> REAL, same budget.
decisions.real: REAL frozen set; formulas with B score > NULL bar = CR1 candidates (FROZEN_CR1.json), reported to the user; DEV not opened by this chain. None above the bar -> CR1 negative on V4, reported.
decisions.veto: found and not found lead to different next steps (REAL vs stop+trainer fix); a 'not found' is attributable because the ruler check (plant formula as the ninth cell, p8, B half, K10 t >= 2) passed before PC. Veto rule not hit.

prereg.why: B5 found p32 but not p8 with the single-formula reward; the marginal reward removes what the combo already holds, so an orthogonal p8 is a larger share of the reward signal than in B5, but 16 tiles x full book is noisy at 8 bp/day. Real: V4 COMBO_V1 itself is ~0, and B5's NULL max already beat its real top 5.

combo_fit.fit: rank IC over the A half: signal every 24 h inside every A tile, 168 h forward, TOP100, real labels
